title: StageState
description: One generated chess encounter. Ephemeral: discarded at stage end. Emitted by the pipeline in docs/04 §3 and consumed by the engine in docs/02.

phase.description: deployment: the player places the King (free) and summons deck pieces whose total spawnCost fits spawnPoints, all on ranks 1-4; durability is paid only at Start. action: begins with the first move; the deck is locked for the rest of the stage (docs/02 §3).

board.description: Sparse map of occupied squares only. Keys are algebraic squares. In the deployment phase it holds only Stage Pieces (enemy army, spawned pawns); the player's King and summons are added at Start.

spawnPoints.description: Summon budget for this stage's Deployment phase: the total spawnCost of the summoned deck pieces (King free) must not exceed it. From data/economy.yaml rules.spawnPoints by act and tier, lowered by the template if it says so. The deployment ranks are the global rules.deploymentRanks.

modifiers.description: Active skill effects. Expiry is ordered by duration in docs/02 §6.

skillLog.description: Skills used this stage, in order. Restrictions such as distinct_targets read it; every live modifier has a matching entry.

targetId.description: The targeted piece: its instanceId or stageId.

cursor.description: scripted only: index of the next move in line.

fellBack.description: scripted only: true once the line broke or ran out and the enemy switched to best_move for the rest of the stage.

endReason.description: Set when status leaves active. checkmate is the only win; every other reason is a loss (docs/02 §7).

instanceId.description: Present only for Hero Pieces (deck-owned); their rarity is read from the deck instance. Stage Pieces have no instance.

stageId.description: Stable id of a Stage Piece (enemy pieces and spawned pawns); unique on the board. Hero Pieces have an instanceId instead.

spawned.description: Marks a spawned pawn: a player-side Stage Piece (docs/02 §2.2). Enemy pieces never carry it.

rarity.description: Only on spawned pawns. Hero Piece rarity lives on the deck instance; enemy pieces are always Normal (I13).

promotesTo.description: Only on spawned pawns: the piece this pawn becomes on reaching rank 8. Rolled at generation and shown to the player.

transformed.description: Temporary override from a transformation skill. Reverts at R1.

allOf.$comment: A spawned pawn is a white pawn with a rarity and a visible promotion result, and no deck instance.

target.description: Id of the piece the modifier applies to: its instanceId or stageId.
